## Global guardrails (apply to every item)

G1. Core primary clone `/Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox` is read-only. Core work uses `make worktree-create BRANCH=... WORKTREE_PATH=...`, then `make agent-write-preflight`. Site work uses a linked worktree of `benchbox-site` on a named branch.
G2. Never `git add -A`. Stage explicit paths. Commit identity is `Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>`. No agent or co-author trailers.
G3. No Python (`.py`, `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, `python`, `uv`, `uvx`) enters the site repo or its history. No JS/TS source enters core.
G4. No hosted ruleset, required-check name or repo setting changes. Core's `docs` required context keeps its name and keeps reporting. If any step seems to need a settings change, stop and report.
G5. Commit messages, PR titles and PR bodies state the durable reason. No tracker IDs, item IDs, plan or handoff references, or run-local state.
G6. Core protected paths (`scripts/site_inputs.py`, `.github/soundness-paths.txt` entries, `quality/comment-policy.json`, `quality/comment-cleanup-scope.json`, ruleset docs) require the oracle review. Resolve every blocking finding. If the oracle is unavailable, stop.
G7. Merge only after required CI is green and the item's verification rubric passed with observed evidence. Never merge on a failed or skipped required check. Merging a site PR to `main` deploys; verify the rehearsal or the receipt before and the probes after.
G8. Any production-visible regression: roll back with `npm run deploy` rollback to the last known good receipt, then stop and report.
G9. Before editing a living policy or spec document that an item quotes, re-read it and diff against the quote. Line numbers cited here are evidence of the research date only.
G10. Core is one-way ahead of the site (D16): core lands a bundle change first, the site adopts it second, core removes it last.
G11. Report only exercised verification. Stored verification commands in items are records to run.

## Stop conditions (any item)

- TypeScript generator output differs from Python output after one fix attempt.
- TPC EULA adjacency check fails.
- Oracle review unavailable or blocking.
- Rehearsal or baseline `dist/` diff shows anything other than edit URLs.
- Any deploy gate fails (privacy, explorer compat, snapshot digest, links, origin).
- A ruleset or repository-setting change is needed.
- Secret scan finds any hit in the filtered history.
- The freeze check cannot be proven (a moved path changed after the recorded snapshot SHA).
